ti["#"] = {"st_rawglass"}
ti["*"] = ti["x"] .. ti["#"]
ti["<"] = {"st_oneway", orientation=WEST} .. ti["="]
ti["o"] = {"st_oxyd"}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_marble_black", "black"} .. ti["="]

wo(ti, " ", {
    "####o###o##o###o####",
    "#:.:               #",
    "#.*.# # # # # # # ##",
    "o:.:               o",
    "## # # # # # # # # #",
    "o                  o",
    "# # # # # # # # # ##",
    "o                  o",
    "## # # # # # # # # #",
    "o                  o",
    "# # # # # # # # ####",
    "#                <@#",
    "####o###o##o###o####"
})

wo:add({"ot_timer", target="chase", interval=cond(wo["IsDifficult"], 0.35, 0.50), state=ON})
wo:shuffleOxyd()

court = no["court#*"]
black = no["black"]
function chase(value, sender)
    if court[fl(black)] ~= nil then
        local abyss = no["abyss"]
        local candidates = abyss + NEIGHBORS_4
        local mindist = 10000
        local winner = nil
        for i= 1, 4 do
            local distvec = candidates[i] - black
            local distsquare = distvec.x * distvec.x + distvec.y * distvec.y
            if distsquare < mindist then
                winner = i
                mindist = distsquare
            end
        end
        wo[abyss + cond(wo["IsDifficult"], NEIGHBORS_8, NEIGHBORS_4)] = ti[" "]
        wo[abyss] = ti[" "]
        wo[candidates[winner]] =  ti["x"]
        wo[candidates[winner] + cond(wo["IsDifficult"], NEIGHBORS_8, NEIGHBORS_4)] =  ti["."]
        court = no["court#*"]
    end
end

lua.code:
ti[" "] = {"fl_metal_7", friction=4.0}
ti["."] = {"fl_abyss"}
ti["~"] = {"fl_water", name="water"}
ti["-"] = {"fl_metal_7", name="court#", friction=4.0}
ti["#"] = {"st_greenbrown"}
ti["="] = {"fl_slope_tw", strength=10}
ti["<"] = {"st_oneway", orientation=WEST, name="oneway"} .. ti["="]
ti["D"] = {"st_death"}
ti["+"] = {"it_trigger", target="addslope", _force_x=0, _force_y=0}
ti["N"] = {"it_trigger", target="addslope", _force_x=0, _force_y=-10}
ti["E"] = {"it_trigger", target="addslope", _force_x=10, _force_y=0}
ti["S"] = {"it_trigger", target="addslope", _force_x=0, _force_y=10}
ti["W"] = {"it_trigger", target="addslope", _force_x=-10, _force_y=0}
ti["o"] = {"st_oxyd", name="left#"}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd", name="right#"}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_marble_black"}
ti["*"] = {"#ac_marble_white", name="white", essential=INDISPENSABLE} .. ti["="]

wo(ti, " ", {
    "##o###o####O#D#O##..",
    "#+  N  +##-------#..",
    "o       oO-------O..",
    "#       ##-------###",
    "#W  @  E#D---~---<*#",
    "#       ##-------###",
    "o       oO-------O..",
    "#+  S  +##-------#..",
    "##o###o####O#D#O##.."})

wo:add({"ot_timer", target="float", interval=0.1, state=ON})
wo:add({"ot_timer", target="chase", interval=1.0, state=ON})
if wo["IsDifficult"] then
    wo:shuffleOxyd({"left#*", max=2}, {"right#*", max=2})
else
    wo:shuffleOxyd({"left#*", max=1}, {"right#*", max=1})
end

local force_x = 0
local force_y = 0
local court = no["court#*"]
function addslope(value, sender)
    force_x = sender["_force_x"]
    force_y = sender["_force_y"]
    court["force_x"] = force_x
    court["force_y"] = force_y
end

function float(value, sender)
    wo[no["water"]] = ti["~"]
end

function chase(value, sender)
    if wo["IsDifficult"] then
        local white = no["white"]
        if court[fl(white)] ~= nil then
            local candidates = no["water"] + (po(0, 0) .. NEIGHBORS_4)
            local mindist = 10000
            local winner = 1
            for i= 1, 5 do
                local distvec = candidates[i] - white
                local distsquare = distvec.x * distvec.x + distvec.y * distvec.y
                if distsquare < mindist then
                    winner = i
                    mindist = distsquare
                end
            end
            if winner ~= 1 then
                wo[no["water"]] = ti["-"]
                wo[candidates[winner]] =  ti["~"]
                court = no["court#*"]
                court["force_x"] = force_x
                court["force_y"] = force_y
            end
        end
    end
end

tspeed= cond(wo["IsDifficult"], 60, 40)
ti["  "] = {"fl_rock"}
ti["- "] = {"fl_water"}
ti[" #"] = {"st_greenbrown"}
ti[" O"] = {"st_oxyd"}
ti[" *"] = {"st_brownie"}
ti[" S"] = {"#ac_top", name="t1", range=1000, strength=tspeed}
ti[" T"] = {"#ac_top", name="t2", range=1000, strength=-tspeed}
ti[" A"] = {"st_switch", target="changetops"}
ti[" z"] = {"ac_marble", 1.0, 0.5}

wo(res.composer(ti), "  ", {
   "-*-*-O-# # # O # # A A # # O # #-#-O-*-*",
   "-*- - -                         - - - -*",
   "-O- - -S                        - - - -O",
   "-#- - -                         - - - -#",
   " O                                     O",
   " #                                     #",
   " A                 z                   A",
   " #                                     #",
   " O                                     O",
   "-#- - -                         - - - -#",
   "-O- - -                         -T- - -O",
   "-*- - -                         - - - -*",
   "-*-*-O-# # # O # # A A # # O # #-#-O-*-*"})

current_state = 0
function changetops()
    if current_state == 0 then
        no["t1"]["strength"]= -tspeed
          no["t2"]["strength"]= tspeed
       current_state= 1
    elseif current_state == 1 then
        no["t1"]["strength"]= tspeed
          no["t2"]["strength"]= -tspeed
       current_state= 0
    end
end
wo:shuffleOxyd()
